title: Bihar Minor Irrigation Department
organization: Minor Water Resources Department, Government of Bihar
vacancyDetails: Minor irrigation projects, water resources and agriculture irrigation services in Bihar.
qualification: Eligibility depends on the selected irrigation scheme or service.
selectionProcess: Application -> Technical and department verification -> Approval

content:
The Bihar Minor Irrigation portal provides information about irrigation projects, water resources and services supporting agriculture.

Check scheme eligibility, location requirements, documents and application instructions on the official portal.
